equipment_type: Make-up air heater / tempered air unit DDC controller
applies_to: CaptiveAire heater (make-up air) units shipped with the factory Direct Digital Controls (DDC) controller covered by IOM A0020659.
summary: CaptiveAire's DDC controller runs a heater or tempered make-up air unit and talks BACnet MS/TP, Metasys N2, Modbus or LonWorks, chosen by DIP switches. The BMS picks the occupancy source, enables the unit through BV 1 when AV 1 = 2, writes heating and cooling setpoints, can call cooling stages directly and send VFD speed and damper signals. It reports intake, discharge and room temperatures, fan, damper, heat and cooling commands and status, and a set of alarm BVs (airflow, filter, freeze, heat failure, high/low supply air, smoke).
notes: Names are the 'BACnet Reference' (or 'Network Reference') printed for each variable.
Access follows the manual's 'Editable'/'On/Off Switch' versus 'Fixed readout' wording; the alarm BVs 31-47 are read-only.
Temperatures are in °F by default and can be changed to °C in software.
Several settings depend on others: BV 1 needs AV 1 = 2; BV 0 needs BV 19 = 0; BV 17 needs BV 18 = 0 (and BV 18 needs BV 17 = 0, as printed).
AV 12 is printed with two different ranges (0-100 % and 1.0-10.0, default 2.0); only the percent range is used here.
Source: List of Analog Variables, List of Binary Variables and Network Alarm Variables, manual pages 6-18 (59 objects).

integration.summary: Set the address on the two rotary switches (default 03) and check the protocol DIP switches are on BACnet MS/TP (factory baud 9600). Write AV 1 ctrl_source = 2 so BV 1 enable_bas runs the unit, then write the heating supply air setpoint AV 3. Monitor occupancy status, supply fan status, discharge temperature, heat command and the alarm BVs.

minimum_points.name: ctrl_source
minimum_points.why: Must be 2 for BV 1 BAS control

minimum_points.name: cl_iat_stpt
minimum_points.why: Intake air temperature to start cooling

integration.enable: AV 1 ctrl_source picks the occupancy method: 0 digital input, 1 keypad, 2 BAS using BV 1, 3 BACnet schedule, 4 override on. With AV 1 = 2, BV 1 enable_bas switches the unit between unoccupied and occupied. BV 15 emerg_alm_in = On shuts the unit down.
integration.remote_sensors: AV 13 vfd_spd_in and AV 15 mod_dmp_in take a network voltage for the VFD speed and modulating damper; BV 8 and BV 10 let the network call cooling stages directly, subject to the unit's safeties.
setup: Protocol (BACnet MS/TP, N2, Modbus or LonWorks) is set at the factory on DIP switches 3-4; switches 1-2 set the baud (factory 9600).
Address is set on two rotary switches (tens and ones), factory default 03; power cycle after changing it.
BACnet MS/TP connects to the RS-485 port at the upper left of the controller.
gotchas: BV 15 is a network emergency stop: On shuts the unit down.
Cooling stage requests (BV 8, BV 10) still need fan status, heating off and the intake lockouts satisfied.
BV 38 alarms if a keypad override is left locked on.
